description: Machine-readable mirror of the capability-gap sections of docs/mapping/chmed16a-ch-emed.md. A difference after a round trip is acceptable only if a gap of the same direction explains it (SC-004). path is a regular expression over the difference path; kinds are REMOVED, ADDED or CHANGED (first document compared with the round-tripped one).

gaps.reason: Patient medical data (weight, height, risks, menstruation, gestation) has no place in the Medication Card
Validation of the medication plan has no representation in CH EMED
Unknown fields are ignored (CHMED16A parsers must ignore them)
Complex taking times and non-daily cycles are carried as free text, the structure is lost
The free text of such a posology comes back as application instruction
A posology with all doses 0 has no dose; the unit and the dates are carried as text
The dates of a posology without dose come back as text in the application instruction
A unit without posology has no dose to attach to
A revision 1 prescription has no healthcare person/organisation; the output is revision 3 with the details from the author option
Product details (form, amount, ingredients) are not part of CHMED16A; the GTIN identifies the product
The product name (display) is not part of CHMED16A
CHMED16A has no product name; Medication.code.text is derived from the identifier
CHMED16A has only the document date; dateAsserted is set to it
The route text is replaced by the CHMED16A route code
The status of a statement is not representable; on-hold statements come back active, and the list shifts when statements are excluded
Stopped, not-taken and entered-in-error statements are excluded
A CHMED16A plan carries only the author GLN; names and addresses come from the author option
Only VeKa identifiers are carried; other identifiers are replaced by the patient identifier option
The country is not carried over
The patient language is derived from the document language
The document confidentiality is not carried over; it comes from the options
Dosage constructs CHMED16A cannot express are carried as text in the application instruction
A prescription has no start date (other than the prescription date), route or treatment reason
